description: This file is an HTML document implementing the frontend interface for a database visualizer. It contains the structure, styles, and JavaScript code handling database, table, and data interactions within a web browser, allowing users to browse and view database contents dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar with clickable database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI to initial state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the expanding/collapsing of a database's table list and triggers table loading.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables of a selected database and displays them as clickable items.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, rendering a data grid.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data in a grid format with scroll and expansion features.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand capability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.
